meta.name: Scooby Doo! Abracadabra Doo
meta.description: The gang goes on a trip to check on Velma's younger sister, Madelyn. She's been studying stage magic at the Whirlen Merlin Magic Academy, where apparently there have been sightings of a giant griffin. The gang decides to investigate.
meta.slogan: The all-new Scooby-Doo movie with a magic touch!
